public_body: Fall River City Council Subcommittee Of Health And Environmental Affairs
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the posted agenda topic on solid waste and recycling costs was specific enough to cover the strategies discussed, and the recording announcement matched a prior determination.

allegations.summary: Alleged the August 19 agenda item on solid waste and recycling costs was too vague to cover subtopics discussed, such as composting and energy recovery.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the posted topic, “Discuss strategies to decrease solid waste and recycling costs,” adequately encompassed the Subcommittee’s discussion of particular strategies to decrease solid waste and recycling costs, and therefore the Subcommittee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Subcommittee did not make an adequate announcement that the August 19 meeting was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: For the same reasons expressed therein, we also find no violation here.
